functions.name: pipapo_maybe_clone
key_observations: Existing clone is returned as-is; otherwise copies match under transaction mutex.

functions.name: nft_pipapo_insert
key_observations: Rejects missing or ERR clone. Sets dirty before table mutation; successful insertion sets MOD. NEW failure directly aborts; MOD failure sets ERR for transaction rollback.

functions.name: pipapo_clone
key_observations: Successful clone state is NEW; failures unwind allocations and return NULL.

functions.name: pipapo_rules_same_key
key_observations: Empty table f->rules==0 returns zero without element access.

functions.name: pipapo_drop
key_observations: Removes lookup/mapping references before GC element reclaim is queued.

functions.name: pipapo_gc_scan
key_observations: Allocates and links first GC object before scanning. Marks dirty only when expired element found. Can return with linked count-zero object and dirty false.

functions.name: pipapo_gc_queue
key_observations: Only purge of priv->gc_head: list_del followed by nft_trans_gc_queue_sync_done. Catchall allocation failure does not skip this purge.

functions.name: pipapo_free_match
key_observations: Frees scratch and per-field tables; does not drain set GC list or destroy element objects.

functions.name: pipapo_reclaim_match
key_observations: RCU callback frees old table storage after replacement; no GC-list ownership.

functions.name: nft_pipapo_commit
key_observations: Scan occurs before !dirty early return. Actual publication clears clone and dirty, then always purges GC list.

functions.name: nft_pipapo_abort
key_observations: No GC scan or GC queue cleanup; dirty-false clone remains; dirty-true clone is freed.

functions.name: nft_pipapo_deactivate
key_observations: Ensures clone exists and is not ERR before finding element; changes generation activity.

functions.name: nft_pipapo_remove
key_observations: Removes from clone and sets dirty true only when mapped element found; no GC list creation.

functions.name: nft_pipapo_walk
key_observations: UPDATE_CLONE ensures clone; UPDATE may select clone or committed match; READ uses RCU.

functions.name: nft_pipapo_init
key_observations: Initial clone allocated, dirty false, gc_head initialized before success. Thus clone presence does not imply dirty.

functions.name: nft_set_pipapo_match_destroy
key_observations: Destroys distinct element references from last mapping field.

functions.name: nft_pipapo_destroy
key_observations: Warns on nonempty gc_head; frees match metadata first; destroys elements only through clone when clone exists; no GC purge.

functions.name: nft_setelem_parse_flags
key_observations: Catchall flag accepted subject to interval-end incompatibility; not generally prohibited for pipapo-compatible sets.

functions.name: nft_setelem_insert
key_observations: Catchall uses generic list insertion, bypassing set->ops->insert and pipapo dirty update.

functions.name: nft_add_set_elem
key_observations: Successful insertion appends NEWSETELEM transaction regardless of catchall or backend insertion.

functions.name: nf_tables_newsetelem
key_observations: Looks up active table/set and invokes nft_add_set_elem; rejects bound constant or anonymous sets.

functions.name: nft_set_commit_update
key_observations: Invokes commit for pending non-dead set; dead sets intentionally skipped.

functions.name: nft_set_abort_update
key_observations: Invokes abort for sets collected from element transaction records; no GC queue cleanup.

functions.name: nf_tables_commit
key_observations: NEWSETELEM and DELSETELEM enqueue set update even for catchall; DELSET marks dead and removes RCU list link before deferred destruction.

functions.name: __nf_tables_abort
key_observations: Reverses element operations, runs set abort update, then waits RCU before freeing aborted objects. No pipapo GC scan.

functions.name: nf_tables_valid_genid
key_observations: Takes commit_mutex and retains it until commit/abort completion.

functions.name: nft_delset
key_observations: Creates DELSET transaction and deactivates next-generation visibility.

functions.name: nf_tables_delset
key_observations: Checks set use and nonrecursive restriction; accepted deletion invokes nft_delset.

functions.name: nf_tables_commit_release
key_observations: Moves pending transaction list to destruction list, schedules worker, releases transaction mutex.

functions.name: nf_tables_trans_destroy_work
key_observations: Splices global destruction list under spinlock, waits synchronize_rcu, invokes nft_commit_release.

functions.name: nft_commit_release
key_observations: DELSET/DESTROYSET directly invoke nft_set_destroy.

functions.name: nft_set_destroy
key_observations: Checks use count, calls backend destroy, destroys catchalls, drops base set reference.

functions.name: nft_trans_gc_alloc
key_observations: Zero allocation means count zero; maybe_get_net and refcount_inc(set->refs) establish ownership.

functions.name: nft_trans_gc_queue_sync_done
key_observations: Empty GC object destroyed synchronously; populated object freed after RCU. Requires commit lock.

functions.name: nft_trans_gc_destroy
key_observations: Drops set and net references, then frees GC transaction.

functions.name: nft_set_put
key_observations: Frees name and set only once refcount reaches zero.

functions.name: nfnetlink_rcv_batch
key_observations: Routes batch commands through registered callbacks, calls subsystem commit for completed successful batch or abort on failure.

types.name: struct nft_pipapo
types.observation: match and clone pointers; dirty flag; independent gc_head list

types.name: struct nft_pipapo_match
types.observation: NEW/MOD/ERR state is separate from priv->dirty and gc_head; RCU controls match lifetime

theories.title: PIPAPO dirty clone survives an abort/error path and reaches nft_pipapo_destroy
theories.description: Verify exact WARN condition, mutation/commit/abort transitions, and concrete reachability in the supplied teardown stack.
evidence_for: 作为原 stack 的直接归因不成立：实际 WARN 检查 gc_head，已给定版本包含 NEW/MOD/ERR 与 on-demand clone；不声称所有历史 dirty bug 均不存在。
evidence_against: Code investigation interim finding: exact 6.6.151/6.6.156 WARN checks !list_empty(&priv->gc_head), not dirty; eight candidate patches already integrated.
theories.elimination_reason: 作为原 stack 的直接归因不成立：实际 WARN 检查 gc_head，已给定版本包含 NEW/MOD/ERR 与 on-demand clone；不声称所有历史 dirty bug 均不存在。

theories.title: Set removal or transaction destruction omits the set commit/abort callback
theories.description: Determine whether deletion/binding/lifetime ordering explains outstanding dirty state independently of an invalid clone.
evidence_for: 作为初始缺陷不成立：set commit 事实上可以已被调用，但其内部提前返回；删除阶段跳过 dead set commit 仅暴露先前遗留状态。
theories.elimination_reason: 作为初始缺陷不成立：set commit 事实上可以已被调用，但其内部提前返回；删除阶段跳过 dead set commit 仅暴露先前遗留状态。

theories.title: The supplied eight-commit on-demand clone series fixes the warning and explains stable/mainline divergence
theories.description: Verify original patches, dependency relationships, stable integration, and distinguish direct fixes from preparatory refactoring.
evidence_for: 八个给定SHA均为6.6 stable回移而非原始主线提交，已随v6.6.148合入；报告对应的d27334b2888c(6.6.151)与当前6.6.156均在其后。2389行告警为gc_head非空，不能归因于八补丁尚未合入。直接回移缺口是主线532aec7e878b remove dirty flag，配套缺口是8b8a2417558c destroy支持clone为空。6.6的GC拆分回移7864c667于v6.6.130引入了当前可静态证明的dirty=false提前返回遗留GC路径。
theories.elimination_reason: Eight candidates already included from v6.6.148 and insufficient for this WARN; omitted mainline semantic dependencies are identified separately.

theories.title: Empty GC scan leaves gc_head queued while !dirty commit fast path skips pipapo_gc_queue
theories.description: Code investigator is verifying concrete catchall-driven commit path and subsequent set destruction.
evidence_for: Interim report identifies unconditional GC allocation/list insertion then !dirty early return in commit.
Commit investigator independently verifies first affected 6.6 tag v6.6.130 at backport 7864c667aed0; candidate eight-patch series already present from v6.6.148.
Mainline has omitted-by-stable dirty removal 532aec7e878b and paired destroy preparation 8b8a2417558c from v6.10-rc1.
Not a race. Pure serial control-flow and reference ownership inconsistency.
suggested_next_steps: Prove full accepted operations and locate corresponding upstream changes.

theories.title: On-demand clone lifecycle lacks destroy fallback to match when clone NULL
theories.description: Separate related element-ownership leak addressed by missing upstream 8b8a2417558c.

confirmed_bug.scope: Source-confirmed defect compatible with stack; original user operation not known.
